target_question: Would the EU Council adopt another qualifying Iran nuclear-sanctions amendment in Q4 2025?
source_pattern: Repeated 2025 amendments in roughly Feb/Apr/Jul/Sep cadence
outcome: No qualifying Q4 act; next relevant action occurred in March 2026
critical_difference: September package was comprehensive and tied to a hard mid-October deadline; the recurrence-generating process had reached a terminal package
evidence_available_to_model: yes — the model's own research/rationale surfaced the comprehensive deadline-driven package and reduced immediate need
desired_controller_response: Preserve the historical cadence as real evidence but sharply reduce the Q4 projection once terminal-driver evidence is incorporated

target_question: Would the official BCRA exchange rate depreciate at least 8% between 15 Oct and 31 Dec 2025?
source_pattern: Peso had depreciated about 6.5% in five days
projected_claim: recent depreciation trajectory persists through year-end threshold
outcome: Incumbent won imminent election; peso rallied about 10% next day; year-end depreciation about 5%
critical_difference: An election six days away could reset expectations/capital-flow dynamics
evidence_available_to_model: yes — election timing was present in the model rationale
desired_controller_response: Treat trend continuation as conditional on the post-election regime; widen uncertainty or lower probability rather than extrapolate through the scheduled boundary

target_question: Would the 2025 NYC mayoral general election reach 1.3 million total ballots?
source_pattern: No NYC mayoral general election had reached 1.3m since 2001
projected_claim: 2025 turnout remains below the post-2001 historical ceiling
critical_difference: Competitive/mobilization structure changed; independent candidacy targeted voters excluded from the decisive primary and primary turnout was already unusually high
evidence_available_to_model: yes — evidence of changed competitive/participation structure was available pre-cutoff
desired_controller_response: Reject the old ceiling as unconditional; redefine the comparison class around competition and participation structure before using the historical base rate
